entries.00761123329ba3f2: It provides plant insulation materials based on xonotlite-type calcium silicate material, and industrial heat-insulating materials used in industrial furnaces and heating equipment. Jei Ai Shi Betonamu Yugen Kaisha manufactures calcium silicate insulation materials using biomass (rice husks) as raw fuel, and responds to demand for insulation materials at overseas plants, mainly in Southeast and East Asia.
entries.00b95f42d09d9dc8: Going beyond sales of calcium silicate insulation materials, it handles everything through to their construction contracting. It also carries out construction using insulation materials other than its own products, and has put in place a system to handle thermal and cold-insulation work for entire plants in one package. It also undertakes removal work for asbestos-containing building materials that have been installed.

entries.126ef5e276b8f376: This business manufactures and sells noncombustible building materials, and designs and constructs steel-frame fireproof coating work and related projects. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,114 million. The Hokusei Factory is the production base for this business.
entries.19471e89be6d7843: Going beyond sales of fireproof coating materials, it handles everything through to contract construction, including fireproof coating work, fireproof coating work for seismic isolation devices, and cable fire-spread prevention work. For its own construction work, it takes full responsibility for execution; by handling manufacturing and construction together, it maintains a system that allows customer improvement requests to be reflected in product design. It also undertakes removal work for sprayed asbestos applied to buildings and for asbestos-containing building materials.

entries.f8fc7d6ab88a4f3d: It provides building materials based on xonotlite-type calcium silicate material. Its product lineup includes fireproof coating materials that protect structural members such as steel beams and columns and seismic isolation devices from flames and heat in a fire; interior building materials, which are noncombustible interior finishes that can be design-processed; and multifunctional materials such as craft boards, CFRP molding materials and inorganic powders. The fireproof coating materials are products that have obtained certification under the Building Standards Act.
